scripts.build: trap 'rm -f .*.bun-build' EXIT; bun build.ts || exit 1; for machine in ${CMOD_MACHINES:-darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 linux-arm64 linux-x64}; do bun build --compile --production --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --target=bun-$machine src/main.ts --outfile dist/inbox-$machine || exit 1; done
